name: TranslateGemma 12B (4B / 12B / 27B family)

lineage.how_derived: SFT (4.3 B tokens) on parallel data incl. Gemini-generated translations, then RL (10.2 M tokens)

purpose: Open translation models for text and for extracting and translating text from images across 55 languages.

license.name: Gemma Terms of Use
license.notes: Terms read at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms (redirects to gemma.ai/resources/terms, Google DeepMind, summarizer): no clause bars commercial use, but use is only allowed 'in accordance with' the agreement; Section 3.2 incorporates the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy and Google 'reserves the right to restrict (remotely or otherwise) usage of any of the Gemma Services' it believes violate the agreement; Section 3.1 allows redistribution of the model or Model Derivatives only if the use restrictions and a copy of the agreement pass to recipients; Model Derivatives include models trained on Gemma outputs ('methods based on the generation of synthetic data Outputs'), while Outputs themselves are not derivatives. The weights sit behind a manual access gate on Hugging Face. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.why_this_design: Fine-tuned from Gemma 3 checkpoints for translation; the card gives no architectural reasons. Context is limited to a total input of 2K tokens.

engine_support.notes: Gemma 3 architecture; community GGUFs found in a Hub listing (a 4B and a Uzbek 4B).

strengths: Dedicated translation quality per size; German is among the 55 languages (assumed, list not read)
weaknesses: Input context only 2K tokens: sentence or paragraph translation, not documents in one call
Card (page text) does not list the 55 languages; German is only implied by de-DE examples. Strict prompt format: a user message with exactly one entry naming source and target language codes.
best_for: Translation of short texts and image text

tona_fit.reason: Google's own translation specialist (55 languages, MetricX 3.60 for the 12B on WMT24++, vendor) that fits every class, but only 2K context and no independent German evidence; general models (Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma 4) cover German-English well, so use it where a dedicated translator is wanted.

sources.note: Gemma Terms of Use, summarizer read
